_about: Rule rows for the LOD Upgrade pack 'Bracing gussets' (gusset plate welded to the support, angle brace bolted to it; bim-ootb prompts/MODELLER_LOD_UPGRADE_PILL.md section 3 and P5 SPEC; BIMCompiler prompts/LOD400_DEFAULT_RULES_SCOPE.md section 8 and 8.1). Every row: value, unit, source. source = 'stated: <where the drawing says it>' | 'default: <standard and clause>' | 'default: ours (...)' | 'unset: ...'. A stated value always wins over a default. Change a row, re-run; no code change. No project value is kept in this file. Rows marked [label only] are shown in the panel and the change list; the generator does not read them. The rows from support_reach_mm to concrete_name_pattern are the SAME rows as modeller/lod/rules/joint_defaults.json (the dialog loads one rules file per pack, so they are repeated here; the witness asserts they stay equal).

support_reach_mm.source: default: ours (search distance from a beam end for its support)

bolt_grade.source: default: ours; AISC 360-16 Table J3.1M names A325M as Group A [label only]

hole_diameter_mm.source: default: AISC 360-16 Table J3.3M, M20 standard hole

bolt_pitch_mm.source: default: AISC 360-16 section J3.3 user note, 3d preferred (min 2-2/3 d = 53.3)

edge_used_mm.source: default: ours (>= Table J3.4M 26, <= section J3.5 12t and 150); also sets the bolt line 35 mm inside the beam end

weld_rule.value: Table J2.4 minimum for the thinner part; never above J2.2b (t - 2 mm for t >= 6 mm)
weld_rule.source: default: AISC 360-16 Table J2.4, section J2.2b [label only]

weld_min_table_mm.unit: thinner part up to mm : minimum fillet leg mm

bolt_head_af_mm.source: default: ours (approximate; no product standard read)

survey_ray_back_mm.source: default: ours (survey rays start inside the beam so overlaps up to this depth are measured)

survey_depth_span.source: default: ours (survey rays are laid at +-this share of the depth about the section centre)

survey_width_span.source: default: ours (survey rays are laid at +-this share of the width about the section centre)

angle_web_min_deg.source: default: ours (a support whose axis makes at least this angle with the beam axis is a web / wall to join to: class STEEL_WEB)

angle_inline_max_deg.source: default: ours (below this the support runs in line with the beam: class STEEL_INLINE; between the two: STEEL_SKEW)

cope_jump_mm.source: default: ours (a spread of clearances above this across the section marks a flange edge: cope needed; reported, not detailed)

support_wall_max_mm.source: default: ours (a measured support wall thicker than this is not a plate/web/flange: refuse)

clash_tolerance_mm.source: default: ours (contact faces are pulled back by this much before the clash test)

parity_max_triangles.source: default: ours (the swallowed-whole parity test runs only on neighbours up to this size; larger ones are thin shell meshes that cannot swallow a part; their surfaces are still tested)

member_material_gate.unit: words; case-insensitive 'contains' on the member's stated material (material_name or a layer material)
member_material_gate.source: default: ours (joints are detailed between steel members only)

member_name_include.source: default: ours (steel section naming: UB, UC, built-up BU-, HSS/BOX, angles L; members and supports are recognised by it)

member_name_exclude.source: default: ours (steel-material elements that are not framing: bars, cables, mullions, stairs, round columns)

concrete_name_pattern.source: default: ours (a support that matches is class CONCRETE; so is any IfcFooting)

plane_tol_deg.source: default: ours (section 8: a leg lies in the plane of brace axis and support axis within this angle; else AMBIGUOUS_PLANE)

gauge_fraction_of_leg.source: default: ours (bolt line at leg/2 from the heel; the AISC Manual gauge table is not read) [label only]

gusset_min_thickness_mm.source: default: ours (gusset thickness = max(angle leg thickness, this))

lap_min_mm.source: default: AISC 360-16 J2.2b(f): minimum lap = 5 x thinner part, not less than 25 mm (the 5t term is computed in code)

filler_max_mm.source: default: ours (section 8.1; a larger gusset-to-leg gap is refused GAP_TOO_LARGE)

filler_flag_mm.source: default: AISC 360-16 J5.2 (bolts through fillers <= 6 mm: no shear reduction; > 6 mm: reduction or development applies, engineer to check)

flange_interval_max_fraction.source: default: ours (the support material interval along the plate normal at the contact is a flange if <= this fraction of the section depth, else a web or box wall)

contact_tol_mm.source: default: ours (measured gap between a gusset contact face and the support face; covers a face tilted up to 10 deg over the lap length)

planar_tol_mm.source: default: ours (the support contact face must be straight across the gusset width within this)

overlap_with_leg_max.source: default: ours a gusset that must sit lower than the leg face (flange face below it) may enter the author's angle by less than its own thickness; more is refused LEG_OVERLAP [label only; the rule itself is: more than the gusset thickness is refused LEG_OVERLAP]

end_cap_tol_mm.source: default: ours (a brace triangle with all three vertices within this of the end plane belongs to the end cap)

end_cap_min_triangles.source: default: ours (fewer end-cap triangles than this: the section is not readable, refused NO_SECTION)

leg_edge_min_mm.source: default: ours (end-cap boundary edges shorter than this are ignored when fitting the leg directions)

support_window_m.source: default: ours (support triangles whose centroid lies within this of the brace end are used for the contact slices)

contact_normal_min.source: default: ours (a contact face whose in-plane normal has a component along the brace axis below this is nearly parallel to the brace: refused NO_ATTACHMENT)

clash_sat_eps_mm.source: default: ours (a part and a neighbour triangle clash only when they penetrate by more than this on every separating axis)

flange_probe_height_mm.source: default: ours (the lap gusset bottom rests on the highest flange face found by rays dropped from this height above the flange)
